modules.name: FreeCAD
modules.summary: Core application module used to create and manage headless documents.

symbols.summary: Create an in-memory document for scripted workflows.
Create a document object by type id and internal object name.
Recompute the document after scripted object and property mutations.

objects.name: App::Document
objects.behavior: Owns document objects, resolves internal object names, and applies recompute to make scripted changes observable.

objects.name: Part::Box
objects.behavior: A document object with dynamic Part workbench properties such as Length after it is added to a document.

properties.name: Name
properties.behavior: Stable internal object identifier supplied to addObject and used by getObject.

properties.name: Label
properties.behavior: User-facing label that may differ from the internal Name.

properties.name: Length
properties.behavior: Dynamic box dimension property set before recompute and verified afterwards.

examples.title: Create a document object and recompute it headlessly
examples.summary: Creates a document, adds a Part::Box, sets Label and Length, recomputes, and verifies the object state.

anti_patterns.name: gui-command-reliance
anti_patterns.summary: Do not depend on Gui.runCommand for headless document construction.
anti_patterns.guidance: Use the Document API directly so examples run under FreeCADCmd and in automation.

anti_patterns.name: skipped-recompute
anti_patterns.summary: Do not inspect derived document state before recompute.
anti_patterns.guidance: Call doc.recompute() after object creation and property mutation before verifying final state.

anti_patterns.name: label-name-confusion
anti_patterns.summary: Do not use Label when a lookup needs the internal Name.
anti_patterns.guidance: Pass the internal object Name to doc.getObject(); Label is user-facing and may not be unique.

anti_patterns.name: dynamic-properties-too-early
anti_patterns.summary: Do not assume workbench-specific properties exist before the object is created.
anti_patterns.guidance: Create the object with addObject first, then set dynamic properties such as Length.
